Subject: What a Dumb Column, By a Dumb Ass 
 
The Detroit Tigers carried Victor Martinez for his bat, knowing he couldn’t play the Field again. Mr. Suckass Fenech should pay more attention to the Fucked up Minor Leagues That Mexican Al Avila has destroyed. If his draft picks are so good, bring them up to the Major Leagues with Real Major League Coaches. Why work with a Coach in the Minors not good enough to be up in the Majors. Perhaps the Free Press should look for a real sports writer as they down size instead of an ass kisser who knows nothing about baseball and got this job having connections. Talk about a Prejudice Writer.    George Kaleniecki 313-410-8024 geokalen@hotmail.com
